system_rules: Original enactment date is not the same as commencement date.
An amending Act is not effective for a provision until its applicable commencement is resolved.
Current revised text must be read with the amendment and commencement tables.
Historical questions must resolve the law applicable on the event date.
No proposition becomes publication-ready solely because its original section has been located.
verified_facts: The 1964 Act commenced as a whole on 1 January 1967.
The 2006 Act has multiple commencement dates for different provisions.
Section 4 of the 2006 Act, insofar as relevant to the core s.31 amendment, commenced on 4 November 2006.
Section 61 of the 2006 Act substituted s.84 and commenced on 4 November 2006.
